cards.title: What is E2E Testing?
cards.content:
End-to-End Testing

E2E testing involves testing an application's workflow from beginning to end. It simulates real user scenarios by interacting with the browser.

While Protractor was Angular's legacy E2E tool, modern Angular projects typically use Cypress or Playwright.

cards.title: Cypress Overview
cards.content:
Using Cypress

Cypress provides a fast, reliable testing experience for anything that runs in a browser. It offers time travel, automatic waiting, and excellent debugging.

describe('Login', () => {
  it('should login successfully', () => {
    cy.visit('/login');
    cy.get('input[name="user"]').type('admin');
    cy.get('button[type="submit"]').click();
    cy.url().should('include', '/dashboard');
  });
});

cards.title: Page Object Model
cards.content:
Page Objects

The Page Object Model (POM) is a design pattern used in E2E testing to create an object repository for web UI elements. It helps reduce code duplication and improves test maintenance by abstracting UI details away from the test logic.
